author: Splades
body:
Username: Splades

Ban Reason: Ban Evasion

Why Should I be unbanned: Ok, so I was only kidding around and I decided to be an idiot and make a montage of me being banned on Avicus with multiple accounts. I got really carried away with my friend DaGoldBrick (who is now also unbanned) and then we realized how immature we were both being in the end.

I am really sorry about giving this server a bad rep and the video is now unlisted. I realized how stupid I was being and that's why I decided to write this appeal so I can participate in future tourneys. It would be great if I could be unbanned since I have friends who play on here and because this server brings back lots of great memories.

Thanks for reading this and please take it into consideration.

~Splade

title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: Newcleus
replies.body:
Splade,

Since the video has  been unlisted and you have been gone for a while, I have decided to accept your appeal.
However, if you try to pull any sort of stunt like that again, attempt to troll staff, or disrupt the community in any fashion, your ban will be reinstated and you aren't coming back.

Regards,
Straightened
Avicus Network Administrator
